headline: Family Bank Kenya Profit Surges 69% on Improved Lending Activity
summary: Family Bank Group's profit after tax increased 69% to 6.07 billion Kenyan shillings for the nine months ended September, up from 3.60 billion shillings reported in the prior-year period.
why: Family Bank is a mid-tier commercial bank in Kenya with a significant retail and small-to-medium enterprise borrower base.

impacts.name: Family Bank Kenya
impacts.why: Sharply higher loan origination and interest earnings lifted nine-month bottom-line performance.
